problem: At a school, 40% of students are seniors, 35% are juniors, and the rest are sophomores. Among seniors, 60% chose a math elective; among juniors, 40% did; and among sophomores, 20% did. A student is chosen at random from those who chose the math elective. What is the probability that the student is a senior?
notes: Original variant of Bedrock Prep's hard 'Probability with Percentages' category. Of all students, 0.4*0.6=0.24 are math-taking seniors, 0.35*0.4=0.14 juniors, and 0.25*0.2=0.05 sophomores; the requested conditional probability is 0.24/(0.24+0.14+0.05)=24/43. Explain the denominator as ALL elective takers. Source category: https://www.bedrockprep.com/problems
